prompt: A cinematic film still captures a vibrant rooftop party at night where eighteen distinct entities populate the scene. On the far left, a woman in a silver dress stands holding a champagne flute while looking at a man in a blue suit who is leaning against a railing. Next to them, a golden retriever sits calmly on the concrete floor, its eyes fixed on a plate of sliders held by a waiter in a black vest. The waiter is handing the plate to a girl in a pink jacket who reaches out eagerly. In the center, a DJ with headphones around his neck adjusts knobs on a mixer that rests on a wooden table. Beside the mixer, a laptop glows with blue light, illuminating the face of a technician in a gray hoodie who is typing rapidly. A speaker tower stands tall next to the table, vibrating slightly with the bass. To the right of the DJ, a couple dances closely; the man in a leather jacket has his arm around a woman in a floral skirt who is smiling broadly. Behind them, a string of fairy lights hangs loosely from a metal pole, casting warm glows on the attendees. Near the edge of the roof, an older man in a tweed cap sits on a folding chair, watching the city skyline. A young boy in a striped shirt runs past him, chasing a red balloon that floats just above their heads. The balloon string is tangled around the wrist of a teenager in a denim jacket who looks annoyed. Nearby, a cat with white paws perches on a low wall, observing the chaos with indifference. A photographer in a green vest kneels on one knee, aiming a camera at the dancing couple. Another guest, a woman in a yellow scarf, points toward the horizon, drawing the attention of a man in a plaid shirt standing beside her. A discarded napkin lies crumpled on the ground near the dog. There is no swimming pool visible on this urban terrace. There is no snow falling from the clear night sky. There is no furniture made of wicker or rattan anywhere in the frame.
